This first application under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure has been filed by the applicant who is in custody in connection with Crime No. 72/2016 registered at Police Station Telibandha, Raipur Dis- trict Raipur, CG for the offence punishable under Sections 420, 409, 120-B, 406, 34 IPC and Section 10 of Nischhepko Ke Hito Ka Sanrakshan Adhiniyam, 2005.

sentences.text: 2. Case of the prosecution in short is that the present applicant who is one of the Directors of the Company namely SUCK India Private Ltd. and Shaining Star Infrastate Company.

It is alleged that in connivance with other Directors and persons, they collected huge amounts from different persons in the name of the company which was spread all through at Raipur and other places with an assurance to return the same with high rate of interest.
Eventually, the office of the Company was closed and the depositers suffered a lot and no refund was made to the depositers.
3. Counsel for the applicant submit that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the case.

He submits that the charge sheet has been filed, that the co-accused against whom the serious allegations are there have been enlarged on bail by the co-ordinate Bench of this Court vide order dated 12.7.2019 and 11.7.2022 passed in MCRC Nos. 2346/2019 and 2405/2022 respectively,
and the case of the applicant cannot be differentiated from them.
He submits that the applicant is in jail since 15.6.2022 and the trial may take some more time for conclusion, therefore, the applicant may be released on bail.
4. State counsel opposes the application for bail.
He however does not dispute that the main accused persons have been enlarged on bail.

5. Considering the rival submissions made on behalf of the parties, the facts and circumstances of the case, that the applicant is in jail since 15.06.2022, that the trial may take some time for Anil Lodhi vs State Of Chhattisgarh on 20 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/110420581/
1 conclusion, and that the other accused persons have already been granted bail, this Court is of the opinion that it is a fit case to release the applicant on bail.

sentences.text:
Accordingly, the application is allowed and the applicant is directed to be released on bail on his furnishing a bond in the sum of Rs.
25,000/- with one surety for the like sum to the satisfaction of the concerned Court for his appearance before that Court as and when so directed.
